name: Ayumu Tokikawa
source:
The head of Fukkou Academy's Literature Club.
She is usually calm and collected, but once she starts talking about old literary works she can't stop.
She is a third-year student like Towa, but has already earned her credits and seems to be devoting herself to literary activities.
The club has two members: Dee and Serena.
